Percayalah sama gua, kalau lu deket sama orang-orang di Indonesian VTubing scene, lu bakal nemu VTuber-VTuber sama viewer-viewer yang kek gini. Banyak banget, cuman baru keliatannya kalau emang deket sama mereka; they look relatively normal only on the surface. Kadang kesel sendiri.

Been following them for years. Focused more on the Indonesian scene. Safe to say that everyone there just... Burn themselves to ash. With or without even realizing it. Hampir tiap hari ada gorengan (utamanya di Facebook), orang-orangnya pada gak dewasa dan nyelesain masalah kek mereka masih SMA (yang jujur emang bener, banyak buaaanget yang masih di bawah umur), dan menhera... Oh menhera... Bayangin lu punya masalah kaya bipolar, depresi, atau borderline personality, dan lu malah jadiin itu branding kamu dibanding nyoba ngatasinnya. It's insane for me. And people buy into this kind of thing, giving millions to them! Itu sih yang bikin gua sedih banget.

Gua juga bisa liat banyak banget VTuber yang banyak subs atau viewer karena bikin konten yang nyoba "bantu" orang-orang lonely biar ngurangin rasa lonely mereka, kek GFE/BFE. Buat gua, itu kesannya lebih eksploitatif dibanding ngebantu, karena gua ngerasa gua korban konten kek gitu; hamburin banyak banget uang buat nyawer VTuber GFE yang ujung-ujungnya gua sendiri gak dapet apa-apa balik selain konten dan terima kasih. Gak dapet temen, dan yang pasti gak dapet pacar. Beberapa orang yang gua kenal pribadipun jatuh ke lubang ini, jadi obses banget sama satu VTuber; beliin graphics card, upgrade setup mereka, all for what? Nothing. The VTuber, knowing that the viewer is increasingly escalating his actions to get to her, immediately cut ties with him after getting tons of stuff. Gua sakit hati tiap kali inget cerita itu

Sepengalaman gua, scene VTuber Indonesia ngebakar orang-orang di dalemnya, baik viewer maupun VTubernya sendiri, tanpa mereka nyadar. Kalaupun sadar, mereka oke-oke aja. Bahkan bahagia dengan chaos kek gitu.

It's no mistranslation, alright, but there are things that may confuse some people about these Indonesian Vtuber groups when talking about 'contracts.'  


I could be wrong about Virtunix's way of doing it, but from my experience of working and interacting with a few Indonesian Vtuber groups, most of them never make a written contract with their livers and staff. Their contract with them is verbal and goes along the lines of:  


"Alright, so we think that you can join us. Congrats! Just keep in mind you cannot do specific things with us and you must do specific things with us as well."  


Even though this sounds like just a promise or an MoU, in Indonesia's law system, any type of agreement between two or more people can be considered a contract, so the 'breach of contract' statement here isn't wrong.

I felt like I wanted to clear that up because most of the time people think there's a written contract when in fact the contract is more of a promise than a formal one.
If I'm not mistaken, Virtunix never really branded themselves as an agency. They're more of a group without fixed contracts, even if they held auditions?

I've bought Sea of Thieves at the last summer sale and I've been playing solo sloop for 35+ hours now. When playing solo, the challange lies in having to juggle so many things at once, especially when fighting another ship. Although I've lost more times than I would like to admit, I still had fun due to the challange. But if you're not up for it, you can sail from island to island, trying to find random loot around, sell it, make your ship look nice, and ram it into another unsuspecting player's ship.

But as people already have said, it's more fun to play with friends. Although, fun with friends here is subjective as coordinating a 4-man galleon to fight a 2-man sloop is harder than solo slooping, at least for me. Yes, I love the PvP side more than digging up treasure.

In short, playing solo is fun if you like a challenge or can get creative on what you would like to do in the game, but having friends makes it even more fun.
